description: This file defines an abstract class 'Supervisor' within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing base functionalities for managing style supervision and interactions with worksheets and cells, including clone handling and style export methods.

classes.name: Supervisor
classes.description: An abstract base class for style supervision within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing methods for binding parents, cloning, exporting styles, and interacting with active sheets and cells.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the supervisor, setting whether the instance is a supervisor or not.

methods.name: bindParent
methods.description: Bind a parent object (Spreadsheet or Supervisor) to this supervisor instance, optionally specifying the parent property name.

methods.name: getIsSupervisor
methods.description: Returns whether this instance is a supervisor.

methods.name: getActiveSheet
methods.description: Retrieve the currently active worksheet via the parent object.

methods.name: getSelectedCells
methods.description: Retrieve the currently selected cell coordinates in the active sheet.

methods.name: getActiveCell
methods.description: Retrieve the active cell coordinate in the active sheet.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the object, cloning object properties except for 'parent'.

methods.name: exportArray
methods.description: Finalize export of the style as an array by calling the abstract method 'exportArray1'.

methods.name: exportArray2
methods.description: Helper method to populate an export array with style properties, handling recursive export for nested style objects.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the shared style component for the current active cell.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Abstract method to build a style array from subcomponents.
